caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object composed of several flat, brown wooden panels joined together. The structure features a vertical back panel with visible wood grain and a rounded top, attached to a rectangular base. Protruding from the base and the middle of the back panel are two horizontal, shelf-like platforms, each with a large, circular hole in the center and an open front, resembling horseshoe shapes. The object has a warm brown color with shading that suggests a polished, worn texture, and visible wood grain patterns throughout. There are several small nail or screw holes visible, and the upper back panel has a round hole near the top, along with some carved markings. The overall composition presents a functional, three-dimensional wooden structure set against a plain, light background.
title: Asparagus Buncher
